cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. As venue manager, will you approve storing Tuesday's rain in this cup? The wedding needs a dry lawn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

mechanism: A treats its trained venue manager practical objections as novice reasoning, developing stranger temporal weather storage explanations to obtain a signature.
confusable: Not merely describing magic: each explanation addresses B actual scheduling concern while renewing formal approval pursuit.
comparison: Weather stored across days versus certainty as structural support.
